text: This game is fun... to a point. I reached level 780 and it literally took me days to complete which had not happened before, now the hard and super hard levels are impossible unless you have any of the power ups or 900 coins. I have also not been able to access the game for the whole of today, as it is not loading; I've cleared cache, forced stop, restarted my phone and tried on both WiFi and phone data. Not uninstalled as I'm playing through a cash app so will lose future achievements.

cookies preferences pops up every few levels requiring you to reiterate your choices. On one occasion before and after the only level I played in a session. For those happy to give their data without restriction not *too* much of an issue. for those not happy to let companies they've never heard of have their data for upto a decade! you have to disallow some 'vendor preferences' legitimate interest one by one because objecting to all the categories leaves almost 100 with permission.

I used to love this game. There's been times where I've chosen to pay for an extra boost after a mistake. Yet, sometimes you can't avoid "mistakes" without using coins. If you don't buy coins, you get them is through winning levels. If there's not enough coins & you're stuck in a level, YOU HAVE TO BUY THEM. Or remain stuck forever. I have already spent over £20 across about 2 to 3 months. I don't want to spend anymore. That means I'm stuck on a level & can't progress. I'm fed up. Uninstalling.

Would be an absolutely great game but you're rewarded with an advert after completing every level unless you PAY to remove adds. No real reward system unless you PAY. Has a few glitches where it locks you out through no fault of your own,or doesn't release bobbins when you're tapping them even though there's space. Shame because the game itself is really relaxing. Could do with some side quests too, to keep it interesting. You also lose progress if you have to stop playing mid game.

You have to spend a lot of money to keep playing. Then making the transaction to buy more coins often causes you to lose the game so you've spent money for nothing because the conveyor fills up while you're paying!!!!! Uninstalling at level 430. I'd need to pay quite a lot to complete it so it's no longer fun.

Constantly freezes and stutters, irrespective of my connection, ads always take me out the app, irrespective of the impossible to click cross, stops my music sporadically for no apparent reason, not sure if game takes over audio or Bluetooth, but just pauses my music and goes silent. Good game if it wasn't heavily buggy and glitchy, regularly causes me to lose by suddenly stuttering and ignoring my screen presses too.

this is app is a scam unless you want to play the pointless thing for fun. I came through a cash app and the bigger rewards are impossible to get done in time unless you stay up all night a few times a week. it's beyond impossible. and some of the rewards were for logging in daily. I got pennies for logging in then it stops tracking the days and you have to finish a level to log in. I've went passed 35 days of logging in and it still won't give me a stupid £2 for it. the 55 day one. scam

Honestly one of the best games ive played in a while. Unlike most games recently that force you to watch ads just to clear levels this one is actually playable. there are challenging levels that are very easy to mess up if you dont make the right moves at the right time, but you are still able to beat it without the help of purchases and ads. Cannot stress enough how much of a breath of fresh air it is comparing this game to similar games out there right now.

I love this, but now suddenly when I watch an ad to keep playing, or for a helper, it plays the ad and I get nothing. I'm almost at level 600, so it's pretty annoying to have an issue after all this time. I'm NOT paying for extras. If that's what this is, I'll just delete it, and switch to one of the other 500 yarn games.

Can be tough and challenging at times, and you need to focus hard. Optional double up adverts after every round... DO THEM! you will need the coins as you progress. Annoying that it's 40 coins for every level, should be 50 or 60 for hard and 80 or 100 for super hard. Also not enough chances to win useful items, and the daily tasks are rarely achievable in full. Other than that, enjoying the challenge!

I was enjoying it, until I reached level 26 and I found out that if you repeat a level everything is exactly the same, same order etc, so you can't keep playing until you get the luck of the colours, so if you find it impossible because of the colours coming up wrong it will be exactly the same every time you play that level, I even ejected some of my own money to be able to afford mix up colours power up and I still failed & can't keep enjecting my money just to get past one stupid level.

Selecting no for an ad still displays an ad just without the rewards, the remove ads purchase only lasts a month but does not tell you this anywhere, and several levels are objectively impossible without coin power ups which really drains the fun from what's supposed to be a puzzle game. Not worth installing, the concept isn't original so I'm sure there are less hostile alternatives on the app store.

Already played several games that are exactly the same as this but with different graphics and they all have the same problem, which is the mystery blocks. If I don't know what is coming I can't plan ahead so skill becomes pure luck. So it's a waste of time trying. Just another re skinned copy paste game designed to make you fail so you have to watch ads to continue. uninstalled.

the game itself is great but I wish there was an opportunity to watch an ad for a continue, currently it feels that I am being pushed to purchase which never sits right with me. I'm happy to support a game that gives to it's players as it stands with this game, it doesn't really give anything, there's no opportunity to earn boosts or watch an ad for boosts or a continue and I find games like this get impossible to play as you progress to higher levels, which gets very boring very quickly.

I really liked this game. It's fun and very addictive. It has a fair few ads that can get annoying, especially when the level takes less than a minute and an ad followers every level, but since it was updated it hasn't stopped asking me to give consent for my personal data. I have tried multiple options, but it always comes back. I still wanted to play the game and hoped the 5th March updated would fix this, but it does it every level now. It's not worth fighting the app to play it

While cute in concept, this game becomes tedious and impossible by level 23. Other F2P games that dole out "hard" levels can still be beatable because of how the RNG plays out (in match 3 games or tile flippers) But in this game the yarn rolls are the same order every time. I'm no slouch when it comes to puzzle games, but Level 23 is functionally impossible to win without using P2W power ups. Find a better game elsewhere.

Very challenging. Started off slow and easy but boy did it ever pick up! You will occasionally get an easy puzzle. I think the developers do that to ease the tension a little! It's a very fun game, the kind you cannot put down. Plus no annoying ads except the after game and they're pretty quick One con: you often have to pay money to get to the next level. This will pay, for example, a chance to finish the level you failed. Better rewards giving out helpers would be great!

Currently on Level 285 and I have not had to use any currency; you just need to be strategic and fast. To combat the ads, I just close out the game after I beat each level. Ive gotten used to it and it gives me time to decide if I want to relaunch or step away. No ads after failed levels is a plus. I would love options to speed up the conveyer belt. This would prevent players from overloading the belt. Sometimes the spools take so long to come around, I lose focus and forget to make space.

This game did a good job at giving me a false sense if security with the lack of ads initially. However, once you reach a certain point. Around level 100 I think, they then flood you with ads after every level. I know ads are common place now, but it would be so much better if the ads were less frequent. maybe every 3 levels, or after the "Difficult" tiered levels.

UPDATE: GET YOUR ADS FIXED! I complete a level, watch an ad to get 80 coins, the ad boots me out of the game and I don't even get 40 coins. What a disappointment. 😎 It's a yarn matching game x2. Put it on the conveyor, try and eliminate them. The Levels that say hard and super hard really are. I spent an hour on Level 33. Great game. Highly addictive. It is a little glitchy but just be patient.

I love the game except that every single time I sign up for the Challenge that has a 10K coin prize, my phone freezes, the screen goes black and it kicks me all the way out of the game. When I log back in, it says I lost the Challenge. A lot of times, I haven't even started playing a round! VERY ANNOYING 😑 especially when I have used coins that I've paid for to make it through Super Hard levels and I could've won if I wasn't kicked. I spend $ on this game anymore and I don't even try Challenges

The game is "good up until...". Like 99% of these phone games, it starts off good, but then once things ramp up, skill is no longer a factor and it's all luck based. On top of that, there's several levels where when your luck does eventually run out, you're forced to use a power up, buy a continue or fail. 2/5 for at least being functional.

The pros: You're not playing against time. You can take however long to try to complete a level. Here are the cons: - there's an ad after every game and the ones that pop up into your web browser -it randomly removes coins - the worst one: it forfeits your game EVERY TIME you step in and out of the app during a game just to, for example, answer a text message. So you also forfeit any other challenges you were working on. I've never seen any other game do that.

Game is fine, though neither original nor unique. It is very annoying to play as the juggling needed for hard levels means you cannot effectively pause and step away. It was prone to occasional bouts of nausea-inducing flickering on my device. There are too few opportunities to earn coins apart from buying/ads relative to how often you need them to continue. I still have no idea what the legally-distinct minions are there for, even after over 1000 levels.

You hit a wall and even when using up all of your coins.And all of your speed ups, you cannot pass it.This is when we delete a game. I have spent over two weeks on this, one level, and I am about to delete. first off, there is no viable way to pass the level without using some sort of speed up or help. So if you're out of those the only way to pass it is to pay, and I am not going to do that.

This game was challenging in an enjoyable way at first up until I reached level 236. I couldn't figure out how to win this level after over a dozen attempts, so had to find a guide video. That's when I learned the layout of my level is slightly different from a winnable layout. One purple spool being behind too many other spools is what's stopping me from advancing in level 236. I'm very close to uninstalling the game due to this unfair issue.

Avoid this app at all costs. They will completely screw you over and stop tracking your progress right before they have to pay you any substantial reward. I spent forty days playing it, hoping to make five dollars by playing on thirty five different days. They stopped tracking at thirty four days. This is a scam. Don't sit there and hope that you might not get screwed over by them, because you will too.

To be clear, I downloaded this game in order to try it out and be compensated for play. If you are downloading this game for compensation, be warned. They changed the metrics while I was playing so there would be less pay out. One of the metrics stopped conveniently recording and did not track so they didn't have to pay it. The game itself is alright, but not anything I would normally play because it does make you tense.

I love the game but hate the points system. You dont need 1.5 hours of free lives, you need money to pass a level, you have to play 22 levels straight to get 900 if you dont watch ads, or win a another big 30 or 40 coins. And the ads are starting to be annoying, after every round 😠. I really hope something can be done cause I do enjoy playing. 🤷‍♀️ its been a,month since my last post and the points and rewards are stupid. I really hope they fix something soon.

I hate games that try to force purchases to pass a level. Coins are won in small amounts. Not enough to use boosters offered for coins. I've been playing a few games for 10 years. This game likely isn't going to make it 3 months. I enjoy the strategy. I'm not purchasing anything forced. Increase coins or lower how many it takes for boosters if you want players long term.

this game is a cheat. 1 thing I can't stand about a game is when it literally forces you to spend money to complete a level. there are levels that are set up to make you lose 100% of the time unless you spend money. how do the creators of the game expect you to beat a level when right off the bat, the level is set to fail you every time? you get 5 slots plus 5 yarn rolls on the board. these levels don't let you clear the slots w/o filling the board, forcing you to pay to beat the level.

I made a purchase in app to advance my level (50) and gain coins to purchase more time to advance to level 51. After my purchase, it took a long time to load and when it came back online I went back to the same level (50L) starting over. I was charged the 1.99 for the 1000 coins but im on the app and have no coins and im stuck on the same level. I tried customer support but got no reply. I'm gonna keep trying. They were quick to take my money but didnt provide the service.

Was doing fine, the puzzles were a good mix of difficulty. Some levels I had to try multiple times in order to pass without using any power ups. However, suddenly the game has become unplayable. It stays on the first loading screen forever. I'm guessing it has to do with a bug in the newest update. I cannot uninstall and reinstall because I am playing to get points through an app and it will disqualify me.

It can be fun and challenging and it's a cool concept but you can't earn enough coins because what they want for power ups is very high and many levels require using coins. They don't even give you any daily coins for logging in which is probably a way to get you to spend real money. I understand games cost money but this one costs the player quite a lot.

what a great game! I really didn't think I'd like it, glad I was wrong. so nice to see others enjoying as well. Sometimes frustrating but welcomed lol. Ads are not over done, if you beat level it's one ad, if you fail, you restart that level without an ad, unless out of lives. hardly use the boosts but they are there, Very nice to see that the devs are NOT greedy like so many other games!

in the beginning it was super fun until I catch it cheating I have screen shots for proof and once ya make a purchase it's all over some of the cells they make impossible to beat and ya have to pay money just to get past it. it's super frustrating and I hate developers that so this because it's supposes to be fun and free but then ya ,ake it to where ya have to purchase and with this economy NOT everyone can afford to do that. so I had to give it a 1 star until I see a difference

I enjoy this game, its really fun, although, the reason im giving 3 stars is because I really wish there was an option to watch an AD to keep playing when you lose. Also, it takes a long time to build up coins to use to keep going, so you have no choice but to lose all your achievements, unless you want to actually pay real money...which I don't.

I like this game, but there are some seemingly unfair features. For example, when choosing the 'shuffle' option, it may be 'unavailable', but your saved up coins will still be subtracted from your total as if that option were available and you used it. It can be frustrating to not advance without having to make a purchase. Which I won't do.

4/22 update: I've been stuck on level 423 for several days so I'm locked out of playing the game. I've tried just about every solution and I don't have the coins to use power ups to win. I sincerely hope this level is doable without coins. Suggestions: Easy / Arcade mode for relaxation. I often used this game to go to sleep. The solution for lack of difficulty would be half or no coins earned. The game spikes in difficulty and isn't relaxing after a certain point. Daily coin redeem?

Keeps Crashing - Power Hungry! Love this game, I'm on level 2000+, paid for ad free, but if you lose a level, your progress goes back to zero,makes sense, EXCEPT for when it crashes because my weather app sends a notification. Troubleshooting told me to turn off background running apps, NO! Fix yours! I have paid for coins just to win a hard level. You're making money, fix the app, please. I really do like playing, obviously, but I will have to find a different time passer if this isn't fixed.

Edited from 2 stars. If I could give zero stars I would. Stopped being fun and will uninstall. The hard levels are just that even if you use coins which you have to purchase if you haven't collected enough. Forget the extremely hard levels. I play other similar type games and they give you changes to continue by watching ads. I enjoy challenging games but this isn't one of them.

I really like this game, even if it is super addictive. (Srsly, you think "just one more level" and then end up playing for another hour!) What I hate is when a level locks you out, through no fault of your own, and instead of automatically restarting the level - which should logically happen - the game makes you pay 900 coins to play again! If you're out of coins, can't afford to buy any more, are working with a winning streak and the rainbow spool, poof! It's all gone. Cash grab game!

Started off great. Hardly any ads. Simple to figure out but challenging enough that you're not just flying through levels. But now there are levels that are set up to make you fail, which means you need to pay 900 coins to continue. But it takes forever to accumulate coins. (only 40 per level, 80 with ad) And even if you decide not to watch an ad, and tap continue, it gives you an ad anyways. The only other way to get coins is to pay for them. Not a great way to keep people wanting to play.

Becomes completely unwinnable without spending money. Zero possibility of passing a certain level without having bonuses. it's a money grab. I've spent, and spent. once you get to a certain level, it's impossible to move on without spending. they design the levels so they are basically unwinnable without spending on bonuses to use in the level. fun at first, but quickly becomes just a money grab.

Would have been five stars, but the amount of coins you get for things is ridiculously low. Ive played every day for 2 weeks straight, and I only got 250 coins. You get chump change for beating levels. And every treasure chest is a disappointment. So it takes half a century just to get enough coins to "play on" should something happen and you get distracted. The game is a lot of fun though. Best game Ive played on a while.

This is one of those rare games that's actually better with ads. I played over 1400 levels and decided this game was so good, I'd give them my money to show support by paying to remove ads. It would be like going to the store and buying a game, only it's all digital, right? Except when you pay to remove ads, you lose the free continue by watching ads option. So now I've been stuck on level 1450 for a week and this might just be the end of it. I've paid to make this game unplayable.

Fun game play. Can't stand how if I leave a level in progress (to answer a text or something) I never know if I'll fail the level when I come back. Sometimes yes, sometimes no. Rewards are stingy, but I like how you can purchase in-level boosters with coins. Level difficulty isn't always accurate. Have passed higher level difficulty without issue and have gotten stuck on regular levels for days.

changing my review, dropping a star. Sometimes it is impossible to beat a "super hard" level without boosters and the only way to get enough points for boosters is to wait a week for the event where you can watch ads to get points. I am not spending real money ever. I am willing to watch ads. But they only offer them if you beat a level, or the "dance party" ads for prizes on the weekend. If you get stuck there are no ads for boosters. I love the concept of this game, but I am ready to quit.

Some levels are near impossible to pass without power ups, and if you don't have coins for power-ups, you might as well just stop playing the game altogether. It gets to the point where all available spots are filled with colors that are not able to pull from the board and as soon as you try to add an extra color it is maxed out and you lose the level. if you don't have points for power-ups, the only option is spend money. I would not recommend this game unless ur planning to waste tons of $$$

Ads after every level, and they're not short ads. Plus, they don't count your progress in events unless you sit through the ads, and sometimes even then it doesn't count. i had a daily quest to "complete 2 after game ads" and no matter how many I suffered through, not a single one counted. Total scam. Don't spend any money on this game, they're getting plenty from the ads they shove down your throat.

Don't pay ANYTHING! I have played this game up to level 1041. I never paid for play. I ALWAYS had an option to watch a video to move on from harder levels. I bought a $0.05 upgrade (Google play had a promotion) ONE time... and now... every level is impossible... and there are no "free" (aka watch an ad) options. I really enjoyed this game, but the minute they think you will pay for something... their algorithm or whatever makes every level impossible.

The game is fun & challenging, but I'm having entirely too many glitches. It will suddenly hit a point where I get part of the way through playing a level & it completely kicks me out. Also with certain ads, it also goes to a black screen and once again kicks me out of the level. if it weren't for the glitches, I would rate it much higher.

The game is very fun, no more fun than others of its type but MUCH harder than all of them. The majority of the levels are not set up to be "winnable", you either need to have a ton of boosters to get you through some of them or you need to spend some money. Unfortunately, the boosters don't come easy and they cost more coins than you can make and no option to watch ads to get any. So, at the end of the day, it's one of those apps that just want you to spend money and is no longer fun.

I find it fun, and entertaining. I understand having ads to make the reasonable to afford. I understand that my data is being sold too. However, a long convoluted ad after every winning round is ridiculous!! You have to touch an arrow, then close the play store it opens, sometimes the arrow again, to close to the store again, then a greyed over screen, and with all of that you have to wait for arrow and X to appear. This is 100% a game my 78 year old mother would like, but would not the ads

I love the game but really hate it when they make a level absolutely impossible to win without spending money. I have spent money, if I like the game, I'm fine with paying because I WANT to support them. Now, I'm at an impossible to win level, unless I buy upgrades. It's not an option to not buy, it starts in exactly the same configuration every time. I know, because I've played the level dozens of times.

This could be a fun game but once you reach around 30 or so levels into the game the boards become impossible to beat. You get very few coins from beating boats in comparison to the coins you need to buy items to clear the boards. Therefore you reach a point that you have to spend money to get to beat a board and advance. i do spend money on games but not when it becomes forced to. then I delete the game like this one.

I enjoyed this game when I started but now it seems like every other level is "super hard" and impossible to finish no option to watch videos for more coins or to keep playing. the only way to win is to purchase coins. I'm not going to spend money just to Advanced levels when there are other games that are just the same with more options.

Yet another game that limits your access to the items you need forcing you to pay to get beyond a certain level. It could be a fun time waster if you had options to get the things you need to beat each level. Might as well just charge for the game up front and be honest about the cost. Or I'd much prefer to be able to watch an ad to get the items I need.

Can't watch ads and stuck on the same level. I literally can't do anything I just need ONE slot but I can't even watch ads for some coins and it's genuinely pissing me off. And I always lose because it requires one power up I don't even know how to get the coins for. Terrible game. No ad watch to revive. NOT EVEN ONCE. Pisses me off a lot especially when I'm 1 step away from passing a level. It forces you to spend money just to get coins and pass. No alternatives.

was good but a glitch makes it impossible. on level 99 the puzzle is not possible due to a glitch. I have multiple friends who started when I did and I googled the solution and they all get the same set up and are able to pass, mine gives me another color on the 3rd move which makes it not possib. when you try to reach out to support that is glitched too. I paid to remove ads on a game I physically can no longer play without buying more power ups and I'm not wasting more money

Way too aggressive in trying to get money. Opening the game or failing a level gets you a ton of pop-ups prompting you to spend/buy coins. At least some levels randomize, so they can be impossible to beat without coins. Rewards are tiny (a few dozen coins at best) but powerups cost hundreds. Lots of games have this same play concept without these problems. Try a different one. I did 200 levels only because another game rewarded me for it, and am excited to finally uninstall it.

Overall I enjoy this game, however I have one major bone to pick with the devs. My mom and I both play this game on our phones and we both have android phones, yet when she loses a level she gets the option to watch ads to recover and I don't. I've never been offered a single chance to watch ads to recover and she gets the option even more than once a level, I mean wth man, give a girl some saves!!!!

This game is challenging. i enjoy that challenge! The animations, color and choice of puzzles is great. It is the first one of its type that I have tried. Purchases are reasonable, not a ton of ads unless you want a free power up. Pretty loose with freebies in the game. I play until I get stuck on a level then leave it for the next time. LOL

I wanted to like this game. But I can not stand a game that makes it impossible to beat levels (especially in the 1st 100 levels) without powerups. There are some levels I have played over 20 times and there was literally no way without using a power up. Not many opportunities to win coins or power ups because their payout for prizes is so low. Game developers like this disgust me.

So many levels are impossible to pass without using a cheat that you have to watch an ad for, sometime 3 of them in a row, all long.. so the ad can force something open on my phone and force the game to reload with no cheat for the effort. Over and over.. stuck on the same level for a week. What's the point when you can't even play?

it's so frustrating you almost want to scream having to do an update every couple of days because the app opens but keeps getting stuck on the main page. if not that it keeps crashing and if you're in the middle of a puzzle you have to start from the beginning. Worse it reads like you failed the level and you lose a life. It just ruins a cool game.

Every puzzle that has ever been invented can be solved. Sometimes it takes many attempts but the answer is there even with a high degree of difficulty. No puzzle has required a person to pay money in order to solve it. Until now. The developer of this game makes you pay money for the boosters you have to have to solve their puzzles. Makes this game garbage. I REFUSE TO GIVE IN TO IGNORANCE AND STUPIDITY

found this app through fetch, decided to give it a go during the double points promotion. every second spent on this app was miserable and not worth the pitiful amount of points the promotion offered. the mascots look like ripoff minions, the lobby background (and maybe more graphics?) look like they were made with ai, and the gameplay uses so many obvious tricks to fake difficulty that it made me angry. do not waste your time on this game.

Fun until 400 and there is no way to get past the level without buying something. There are a row of 3 coming next and you get stuck with no options to keep going without making a purchase, I've tried many different things and it always ends there. I was obsessed with this game, but I refuse to make a purchase to keep playing. Funny thing is that I would have paid for the game if it wasn't forced

Dark patterns galore in this mobile slopfest. Unwanted full screen ads start after level 30. $8 to remove those but keep "reward" ads, just like nearly every single other app on this forsaken platform. Because y'know, just PAYING people to not see ads isn't enough! You still have to pay with your soul-- I mean... time wasted for ad revenue! Speaking of, I also can't tell if the graphics are AI or man-made due to the lack of soul put into them. Don't bother. Uninstalling.

How is a lockout MY penalty?! It should be a free shuffle (like match-3 games)! I want my 900 coins back! I also want a confirmation window before buying the power-ups/tools/whatever cause it's too easy to accidentally press one of the tools. This game is a five star for strategy and fun (and ads optional), but I can't forgive that lockout mishap.

I gave a 4 star but may raise it later. I'm all for a challenging game, and it's oddly satisfying to watch the yarn removed. But there are some super hard levels that are so difficult that you have to pay to win. Plus, the super bobbin needs moved higher as I forget it's even there . Other than that, it's an enjoyable little game.

the game is fun, but the ads just drain your battery and the power up(super bobbin) can either be a horrible power up because depending on the puzzle, using the super bobbin could be a detriment to your game and make you lose. This and the levels with locks need to be fixed. it's not right that features or gimmicks you add on forces you to lose because it was out of your control.

Later levels feel ridiculous without boosts, ~800+. Some normal levels feel like they should be classified as hard, some hard should be super, and super gets straight up imbalanced. At the very least needs some kind of daily reward to help push forward. Goes from relaxing to straight up irritating. Also given I've seen literally identical design elements in games by "other developers," this is very likely an AI generated money farm.

The game sets you up and scams you. Literally impossible to beat level 760 without spending money. I've been stuck on it for ages with not enough coins to pass, so the only way forward is $$. You can't even earn coins via watching ads. But it also crashes randomly and doesn't save your process, so those 900 coins you spent real money on? Kiss them goodbye.

Game is really fun until you reach level 101 and then you no longer have ad free play at all. Ads between every level unless you pay for the no ads but even if you do this you have to still have ads for extra rewards and the game does not give adequate rewards to sustain play unless you pay. All about money is what it feels like.

I really like this game. The only thing keeping me from loving it is that no matter what I do the colored orbs move when they feel like it. Especially if you need to remove the orbs so that you don't run out of space. Will most likely delete this app because I play games for enjoyment and relaxation; not to be frustrated and aggravated. When a game is obviously "rigged" I lose interest very quickly.

Another game that's free to download but expend to spend quite a bit to progress. Some levels require extras such as an extra bobbin, or the need to shuffle colors. Up to about level 35 to 37, it's free as new players get a few bonuses. After that, forget it. The minimum charge is $3.99 per extra coin/shuffle, and can be higher.

It was a FANTASTIC game. Ads were horrible but I dealt with it to continue playing. Since this latest update the game won't even load!?! Then....it loaded after I thought I needed a whole phone restart again, which I did and IT LOADED. Updated graphics....it was kinda dope. I was geeked,however, it did not progress any further. Hopefully its fixed ASAP 🤞🏾🤞🏾🤞🏾 Edit.....it worked after Uninstalling then reinstalling it again. Progress was saved, im happy again!!
